■ Psychic Link—At the start of your turn, if you have Big Promo! Zabi Flower in the battle zone, link it to this creature and flip this creature to its higher cost side.
■ This creature gets "Power attacker +1000" for each Alien in your graveyard.

■ このクリーチャーは、自分の墓地にあるエイリアン1枚につき「パワーアタッカー＋1000」を得る。
